newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising on selective buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks are expected to recover on Sunday from Saturday's fall on buying of selected blue chips, brokers said.
"We have got good (buying) orders for good shares. The market may make a quick recovery," said broker Sabbir Ahmed.
Another broker said the market would remain mixed. Brokers said food and financial shares might rise on retail demand as most are seen to have bottomed out during a long correction.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed 5.19 points or 0.27 percent down at 1,874.39 on turnover of 56.6 million taka on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
